purpose: Repeatable interactive acceptance through visible UI and native touch input

safety.target: Disposable synthetic Pokemux fixture only; no existing cmux terminals

Tap visible terminal
Tap three letter keys on the iOS keyboard
Dismiss keyboard using native control
Tap terminal again
Tap another letter key
Repeat dismissal and engagement once more
expected: No focus-induced page zoom
Each keyboard engagement shows rail immediately above native keyboard
Cursor stays above rail
Dismissal returns rail space and full view
Exactly one input delivery per letter tap
